# Compatibility Requirements Checklist: PostgreSQL 18 Compatibility for KalamDB 0.8

**Purpose**: Author check that the compatibility requirements are complete, specific, consistent, and measurable before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the set of behaviors inside the "agreed scope" of full PostgreSQL 18 compatibility enumerated, rather than only the status labels and the rule that a recorded gap stays incompatible? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the interactions between subscriptions, user-scoped data, schema changes, type changes, and transactions specified, rather than only required to be defined later? [Gap, Spec §FR-090]
- [ ] CHK003 Are hot-row rules stated as requirements: values stored without column names, identity kept on the key, one envelope for tabular data, and a row written under an older column list still readable after add, drop, rename, and type change? [Gap, Spec §FR-067, Spec §FR-152]
- [ ] CHK004 Are encrypted connections, `COPY`, extensions, procedural languages, backup, and replication each either inside the required 0.8 matrix or named as exclusions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-110, Spec §FR-112, Spec §FR-121]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the type families that must be finished before execution work starts named? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK006 Is function-value and V8 behavior included in release sign-off, or allowed to follow this release? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-160, Spec §SC-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the "ordinary application slice" defined as the same fixture as the developer journey? [Clarity, Spec §FR-084, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the isolation levels and lock modes covered by "match the baseline" named? [Clarity, Spec §FR-088]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "Rust" in the client suite identified as a specific PostgreSQL driver, with a version pin? [Clarity, Spec §FR-115]
- [ ] CHK010 Is a "removal milestone" for a temporary adapter defined as a release, a task, or a condition that can be checked? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-075]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the spec separate an `ALTER` that must reject an incompatible type change before commit from a later read of rows already stored in an older compatible representation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-152]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the operations covered by "recovery from interrupted operations" named, including flush, data-definition, upgrade, and restore? [Clarity, Spec §FR-141]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Does "default table behavior must be specified" agree with the later rule that ordinary tables default to shared storage and per-user storage stays an extension? [Consistency, Spec §FR-044, Spec §FR-159]
- [ ] CHK014 Do allocation and latency numbers live in one place, given that one requirement only says budgets must be defined and a success criterion states 20% and 10% by reference to a contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-062, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK015 Does "incompatible conversion must not be postponed to SELECT" agree with reading an older row under a newer type by converting at read time? [Conflict, Spec §FR-152]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the type-model completion rule and the function-path success criterion stay independent, so a passing type slice is not treated as function-path evidence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-076, Spec §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK017 Does delivery order place schema migration after the grammar gate, while still allowing the stored-format decision to start earlier, without two different start rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can "parse-count, malformed-input, allocation, and retention checks pass" be judged from the grammar completion requirement alone, without numeric limits? [Measurability, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK019 Are limits that forbid a slowdown against the current storage format stated separately from the 20% allocation and 10% runtime improvement targets? [Measurability, Spec §FR-157, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK020 Is catalog completion measurable from the versioned inventory of every catalog and information-schema view, rather than from a client-query subset? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-094, Spec §FR-108]
- [ ] CHK021 Is migration success defined as typed contents, constraints, indexes, and sequence state, not row counts alone? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-158, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Does the spec require that a matrix row is not marked verified from syntax-only or parser-only evidence? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-029, Spec §FR-081, Spec §FR-136]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements specified for a reader that still holds the pre-rename stored format while writers already use schema identity? [Coverage, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements specified for `search_path` `"$user"` when that role has no schema? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements specified for schema-revision exhaustion, including the error a caller sees and the rule that identifiers do not wrap? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-153]
- [ ] CHK026 Is downgrade behavior specified (newer rows refused by an older server, or a dual-read window), or only the existence of a policy? [Gap, Spec §FR-153]
- [ ] CHK027 Are partial-failure requirements specified for a rewrite batch that stops before it finishes? [Recovery, Spec §FR-149]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Is the rule for reconciling the earlier dialect specification stated, including which terminology wins when the two documents disagree? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Are the related issues that keep their own scope listed so this specification cannot close them by declaration? [Dependency, Spec §FR-138, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- An item passes when the spec or a contract it cites states the requirement clearly enough to implement without inventing the missing rule
- Items marked Gap, Conflict, or Ambiguity are the ones to fix in the spec before implementation
